definition: to let someone out of confinement
description: A snow monkey with a red face sits hunched on a snowy wooden railing in a forest, sealed inside a thick shell of clear ice that covers its whole body. A person in a dark blue coat and yellow work gloves leans in and taps at the ice with a small hammer. The shell cracks, and the person lifts the whole hollow casing of ice off the monkey and holds it up, dripping with icicles. Underneath, the monkey shakes itself out on the railing, loose and dry.

de.answer: Die Person befreit einen eingefrorenen Affen.
de.question: Was macht die Person?

es.answer: La persona está liberando a un mono congelado.
phrases: estar sentado atrapado en el hielo
